title: Six-class metered rho v13e: prime-window detector, pooled mu 1.107, truncated-key 147-instruction step, claim 126.9769

claims.statement: Conditional analytic secp256k1 ECDLP claim: the specified six-class (negation and GLV) parallel rho walk with doubling escapes, a global work meter and a 2^16-node report partition recovers a uniform challenge logarithm with probability at least 0.391002 within 2^126.9769 classical target-operation equivalents at protected C=1000. Let r be the secp256k1 order, N=(r-1)/6, R=2^20 twisted table entries, DP spacing 2^69, 2^20 workers, 2^16 storage nodes with 2^44-record caps, 192-byte records. S_ops=ceil(sqrt(2*mu*N'*ln(1000/608))) with N'=N*R/(R-1) and mu=1.107, the upper 2-SE bound of an inverse-variance pooled calibration over six toy configurations (q25/q29 x R in {256,1024,2048,4096}, 8,800 trials): mu_hat=1.069618, SE=0.018344, mu_charge=ceil((mu_hat+2*SE)*1000)/1000=1.107. S_ops=2^126.777348 arrivals. The ordinary step is priced 1.147 units: one reference batched affine addition (C=1000, 6M=1074, charged 1.0) plus 30 itemised rows totalling 147 instructions, including nine key/detector rows. The distinguished-point gate (top 20 bits of the canonical 64-bit fraction) and the 192-bit class key (three 64-bit fraction words in canonical order) are built only from the eight-product truncated high bits; no exact beta*x and no low bit of x is on the charged path. The near-tie fallback recomputes the exact orbit, rate at most 294/2^64, charged at 2^-50 and 2^12 units < 2^89. Doubling is 2.35 (7M+6A+3M inversion share+200 control = 2,320 instructions, rounded up). The detector is a prime 67-step window with the phase derived from the class key, a full-point-confirmed two-cycle compare, and a boundary escape iff the current canonical point equals the window's running minimum; the claimed composite-cycle cap is 66, with detection bound 67*66=4,422 arrivals. Adversarial enumeration of all L=2..66 x 67 phases x L offsets = 148,070 runs gives 148,070 escapes and 0 failures; a fixed 64-window fails at 3/4, 7/8, 15/16, 31/32 and 63/64 offsets for L=4,8,16,32,64 respectively. Phase 1 = 1.147*(S_ops+2^60) = 2^126.9752132; hard extras 2^89.0000007; expected doubling surcharge (1/(6R)+2^-20)*(2.35-1.147)*S_ops = 2^107.2663769; W_exact=2^126.9752149. The claim 126.9769 is the smallest 1e-4 decimal with 2^(claim-2e-5)>=W_exact and success(claim)>=0.391; success = 0.392 - 0.000997 Markov early halt - 1.19e-7 all other losses = 0.391002. The mu tolerance at the 0.39 floor is 1.110677, above the charged 1.107. The toy production mechanism recovered 2,000 of 2,000 verified logarithms at q25/R=2048 (DP spacing 8), exercising 163 two-cycle and 2,541 checkpoint escapes with 0 exceptional additions; the merge test made 80,000 class-sequence checks with 0 failures; the index rule made 400,000 random plus 74,777 adversarial checks with 0 mismatches and worst error 8 ulps. H1 (all-arrival collisions at the pooled mu and the 2^-20 structural rate for cycles longer than 66), the six-class twist-uniformity clause, routing uniformity and the instruction ceilings are disclosed heuristics supported at toy scale only; this is not an unconditional theorem, no production execution and no practical break is claimed.
